description: What micro1's, Telegraph's and Grepped's own public estimators give for a company's records, from team size, years in business and headquarters. Grepped prices from the kinds of records held, so pass records for its figure. Each range is the buyer's formula, checked against its live page on the date given; none is an offer and Dataconto adds no figure of its own. Pass offer_usd (and offer_from) to place an offer the owner received against each range and the offering buyer's published range. Also returns the other listed buyers these answers don't rule out.

country.description: Headquarters: us, uk, ca, au, eu4 (Ireland, Netherlands, Germany or France), eu (another EU country), in, sg, other. Default us.

offer_usd.description: An offer the owner received, in US dollars.

records.description: Kinds of records the company still has. Grepped's estimate needs at least one; without them it returns no figure.

staff.description: People now, or at the peak.

status.description: Default operating. micro1's estimator covers running companies only.

name: estimate
title: Run three buyers' published payout estimators
